auth.faceExplanation: Your phone may use your face, fingerprint, or screen lock, depending on what you have set up.
auth.faceUnavailable: This browser couldn't set up Face ID. You can keep using your PIN.
auth.faceSignInFailed: Face ID didn't sign you in. Try again or use your name and PIN.
auth.familyAddress: Paste the family address or your private key link
auth.makePin: Choose four digits you can remember. Avoid birthdays, years and easy patterns.
auth.askReset: Ask the organizer for a new key
auth.helperInstructions: Open this key on the phone or tablet {name} will use. If they don't have one, ask the organizer to set you up as their helper.
auth.keyForSomeoneElse: This link is for {name}. This phone is signed in as {current}.
auth.name: Name or nickname
auth.noActivity: Your sign-in activity will appear here.
auth.confirmSignOutAll: You'll need Face ID or your PIN the next time you open the exchange on any device.
auth.homeScreen: Add the exchange to your home screen
auth.homeScreenHelp: On iPhone, open this app in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen. The icon may ask you to sign in the first time.
auth.requestAt: Asked for a new key on {at}.
auth.helper: Who helps on their own device?
auth.hasOwnDevice: They use their own phone or tablet
auth.keepApart: Keep two people apart in the draw
auth.sendKeyInstructions: Send each person's key in a private chat, or give them a card in person. Share the family sign-in address for coming back without a key.
auth.keyQr: Scan to open your private key
auth.keyMessage: Hi {name}! This is your private key for our family gift exchange. Tap the link on your phone and keep it to yourself. {url}
auth.resetMessage: Hi {name}! Here's your private key to make a new PIN for our family gift exchange. Keep this link to yourself. {url}
auth.familyAddressOnCard: To type your code by hand, open {url} and choose “I have a 6-character key code.”
auth.noResetRequest: There is no open request for this person.
auth.resetConfirm: Confirm with them first. If their old PIN still works, they can keep using it until they redeem the new key. A safety lockdown may already have cleared it. They'll see this in their sign-in activity.

event.pinLocked: Too many wrong PINs. PIN sign-in was locked for 15 minutes.
event.newDevicesLocked: Too many wrong PINs. PIN sign-in from new devices was locked.
event.resetPrepared: A new key was prepared after your PIN reset request.
event.resetPreparedWithoutRequest: A new key was prepared without a PIN reset request.
event.resetSent: A new key was sent to reset your PIN.
event.resetUsed: A new key was used to replace your PIN.
event.keyDisputed: Someone with your used key reported that its first use was not them.
event.familyLockdown: Everyone was signed out for safety.

feedback.pinMatch: The PINs are different. Type the same four digits in both boxes.
feedback.pinPattern: That pattern is easy to guess. Pick four digits that don't repeat or run in order.
feedback.pinDate: That looks like a date or year. Pick four other digits your family can't guess.
feedback.invalidPin: That PIN didn't match. Try again.
feedback.pinLocked: Too many wrong PINs. Wait 15 minutes or try Face ID.
feedback.newDevicesLocked: PIN sign-in on new devices is locked. Use Face ID, a device you've used before, or ask for a new key.
feedback.tryLater: There have been too many tries. Please wait a bit and try again.
feedback.invalidName: Enter a name within the length shown.
feedback.inviteInvalid: That organizer invitation code didn't match.
feedback.familyAddressInvalid: Enter the family sign-in address or your private key link from the organizer.
feedback.unavailable: This entry isn't available. Check the link or ask the organizer for help.
feedback.forbidden: Your account can't make this change.
feedback.otherPerson: This device is signed in. Switch person before continuing.
feedback.usedKey: This key has already been used. Sign in with your PIN or ask the organizer for a new key.
feedback.resetRequested: The organizer has been asked. Look for a private message from them with a new key.
feedback.reported: Reported. Any other device linked to this activity was signed out.
feedback.drawStarted: The draw has started. Use the exchange's draw controls to change who takes part.
feedback.invalidHelper: Choose a helper who can sign in and is able to take care of this person.
feedback.shareUnavailable: The share menu isn't available here. Try WhatsApp or copy the message.
feedback.faceAgain: Sign in with Face ID again before changing your PIN.
feedback.keyDisputed: Reported. Your account has not been changed. Ask the organizer for a new private key.
feedback.familyLockdown: Everyone was signed out for safety.
feedback.needsNewKey: This account needs a new private key.
feedback.operatorRecovery: Ask the person who runs this app for a new organizer key.
feedback.previewAgain: Check your code again before continuing.

lists.noItemsOwn: Add something you’d like to receive.
lists.noItemsOther: This list is empty for now.
lists.emptyGetting: When you mark a gift, it’ll appear here.
lists.budgetHelp: Enter an amount in US dollars, or leave it blank for no budget.
lists.linkHint: Paste the store link or the text shared by a store app.
lists.photoFallback: No product photo available. Add a photo?
lists.title: Item name
lists.saveOnLeave: Changes save when you leave a field.

feedback.not-found: That item or list isn’t available.
feedback.invalid-item: Check the item name, note and price.
feedback.invalid-budget: Enter a dollar amount with up to two decimal places.
feedback.list-full: Your list has 300 items. Remove an item to make room for another.
feedback.item-changed: This item changed. Reopen it and try again.
feedback.invalid-photo: We couldn’t open that photo. Try a different photo or screenshot.
feedback.storage-unavailable: Photo storage is unavailable. Try again later.
feedback.invalid-link: Paste a complete link from the store.
feedback.unsafe-link: Use a public store link that starts with http or https.
